method: Same ordered first-parent PR ranges as strict-lint-70-pr-repair.json. Pinned candidate CLI --security-gate --base on each clean detached historical checkout with no project commands, drift and sensors skipped. Static inspection only, default two built-in adapters. Manifest list contains existing changed regular package.json files. Secret source dedup uses Git blame origin commit/path/original line plus rule. Source classification is only asserted for a literal match to a provenance-identified published example. No finding content, match or source location is retained.

read_error_diagnosis.diagnostic: Exact historical checkout, candidate createFsReadonlyIo.readText returned null for the single changed regular input over the reader size limit. Dependency adapter did not start.

1.evidence: Exact match to the publicly identified AWS IAM documentation example.

2.evidence: Test input marked as an example. All 48 payload characters are accounted for by two ordered alphabet and digit sequences.

3.evidence: Test input marked as an example; the entire identifier suffix repeats a single placeholder character.

4.evidence: The same sample occurs in test inputs; the full identifier suffix consists of consecutive alphabet letters.

5.evidence: An isolated quoted PEM header in a test assertion. The test file contains no corresponding key terminator.

6.evidence: A quoted test assertion uses consecutive digit and alphabet sequences covering both payload segments.

interpretation: The scanner correctly matched the patterns. All six distinct sample strings observed in this bounded cohort have affirmative public-example or constructed test-input provenance. No authentication was performed. Existing changed package manifests were read and parsed but the sample yielded no dependency findings, so dependency detection precision is undefined. 51 findings and 33 blame-origin source rows count only the 69 completed ranges; the 39 partial findings at #697 are separate; the six distinct sample strings also cover the partial run. Whole-file change scope includes historical fixture copies. This is a local retrospective in one repository, and no error rate for production secrets is inferred.
source_identity: Opaque source IDs hash Git-blame origin commit, original line number, origin filename and rule; multiple matches in a line can share one source ID. Sample IDs denote exact byte equality in process. Finding text, matched values, and finding locations are omitted.
